standard_prerequisites.name: The Godement construction setting
standard_prerequisites.statement: The functors F, G, the simplicial object X with its augmentation epsilon : X to Y and the maps d and s, as fixed in the author's Example example-godement-functorial (retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the setting of the statement and fixes the notation (source lines 6575-6583).

standard_prerequisites.name: Whiskering of natural transformations
standard_prerequisites.statement: Horizontal composition of natural transformations, written star, and its associativity and compatibility with identities.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is what defines h_n and what makes h a morphism of simplicial objects (source lines 6589-6597).

standard_prerequisites.name: Simplicial objects and the maps X_0 to X_n
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a simplicial object X the maps u_n : X_0 to X_n induced by the unique morphism [n] to [0] assemble into a morphism from the constant simplicial object on X_0 to X.
standard_prerequisites.use: It shows that the family (h_n) is a morphism of simplicial objects (source lines 6593-6597).

core_obligations: Construct h: define u_n : X_0 to X_n from the unique [n] to [0] and set h_n = (1_G star u_n star 1_F) h_0 (source lines 6587-6590).
Show h is a morphism of simplicial objects: use that (u_n) is a morphism from the constant simplicial object on X_0 to X and that h is a whiskered composite of h_0 with it (source lines 6592-6597).

Verify the section identity: compute epsilon_n (1_G star u_n star 1_F) h_0 = epsilon_0 h_0 = id, using that epsilon is a morphism of simplicial objects and the hypothesis on h_0 (source lines 6599-6608).

proof_roadmap.step: Define u_n and the candidate morphism h_n by whiskering h_0 with u_n.
Use that (u_n) is a morphism from the constant simplicial object to see h is a morphism of simplicial objects.
Compute epsilon h = id from the hypothesis on h_0 and the compatibility of epsilon.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-godement-section at source lines 6573-6584: in the author's Example example-godement-functorial, a transformation h_0 : G F to G Y F that splits the augmentation of Y yields a morphism h : G F to G X F of simplicial objects with epsilon h = id. The proof at source lines 6586-6609 defines u_n as the map X_0 to X_n corresponding to [n] to [0], sets h_n by whiskering u_n with h_0, observes that the family (u_n) is a morphism from the constant simplicial object on X_0 so that h is a morphism of simplicial objects, and finally computes epsilon_n h_n = epsilon_0 h_0 = id using that epsilon is a morphism of simplicial objects and the hypothesis on h_0. It is short; the substance is the whiskering bookkeeping and the two structural facts used at the end.
